name: Stormbringer: Everlasting Invigoration extends the Air Elemental buff natively (#3078)

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
BASELINE: Invigoration (680918) keeps its native 15000 ms duration with no Everlasting Invigoration rank known
DISCRIMINATING: Everlasting Invigoration rank 1 (706628) adds 5000 ms via the native SPELLMOD_DURATION family-22 mask
DISCRIMINATING: Everlasting Invigoration rank 2 (707800) adds 10000 ms via the same native mask

contract: #3078: Everlasting Invigoration rank 1 (706628, tooltip 'Increases the duration of Invigoration by 5 sec') and rank 2 (707800, '...by 10 sec') are both SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) with EffectMiscValue[0]=1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION) and EffectSpellClassMask[0]=1, SpellFamilyName 22, targeting the caster. Invigoration (680918) has SpellFamilyName 22, SpellFamilyFlags (1,0,0) and DurationIndex 8 -> SpellDuration.dbc row (8,15000,0,15000) = 15000 ms base. Aura::CalcMaxDuration resolves the pet-cast 680918's spell-mod owner to the owning Stormbringer (Unit::GetSpellModOwner) and applies the player's SPELLMOD_DURATION, and SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod explicitly skips the attribute gate for SPELLMOD_DURATION, so 680918's SPELL_ATTR3_ONLY_ON_PLAYER does not block the match; the family/class mask check (IsAffected(22, flag96(1,0,0))) passes because 680918 carries exactly that family mask. Expected values: 15000 ms unmodified, 20000 ms with 706628 (4999 base points + 1 die side = 5000), 25000 ms with 707800 (9999 + 1 = 10000). No module code implements or blocks this; the assertion exercises player->ApplySpellMod with the same op Aura::CalcMaxDuration uses, so it proves the exact native path the tooltip promises.
